# 1. ABRicate
## 1.1 Loading the database
```{r}
abricate = read_tsv("Supplementary_table19.tsv", col_names = TRUE)
```

## 1.2 Cleaning the abricate data
```{r}
# Extracting MAGs name and database name
abricate <- abricate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MAGs = str_extract(`#FILE`, "(?<=Abricate_out/)[^/]+"),
                Database = str_extract(`#FILE`, "(?<=\\.)[^./]+(?=\\.tab)")
                )

# Replace all the dots values with NA values
abricate[] <- lapply(abricate, function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
  if (is.character(x)) x[x == "."] <- NA
  x
})

# Remove all the empty lines
abricate <- abricate %>%
  filter(NUM_FOUND != 0)

# Remove all the empty columns
abricate <- abricate %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Reorder the columns
abricate <- abricate %>%
  select(MAGs, Database, NUM_FOUND,everything())
```

## 1.3 Merging with transmission data and metadata
```{r}
# Check if all MAGs are found in genome
all(abricate$MAGs %in% instrain_related$genome) # TRUE

# Merge abricate with instrain_related using a left join
abricate <- abricate %>%
  left_join(instrain_related %>% select(genome, VG_ID, howborn, classif, ATB_med_M, Species), 
            by = c("MAGs" = "genome"))

# Merge metadata to add district
metadata <- read_tsv("VG_metadata.tsv")

instrain_related <- instrain_related %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(VG_ID, district, district_cat), by = "VG_ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  distinct()

# Number of transmitted MAGs with ARG mapped on them
n_distinct(abricate$MAGs)

# Number of related pairs with ARG found
n_distinct(abricate$VG_ID)
```

# 2. Effect of co-variables on ARGs carriage
```{r}
# Create an ARG column (Yes/No)
abricate <- abricate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ARG = if_else(if_any(c(`tet(Q)_1`,
                                       `cepA_beta-lactamase`,
                                       `(Tet)tetW`,
                                       `(Bla)cepA-49`,
                                       `cepA-49_1`),
                                     ~ !is.na(.)
                                     ),
                              "Yes", "No")
                )

# Add it to instrain_related table
instrain_related <- instrain_related %>%
  left_join(abricate %>%
      select(VG_ID, ARG) %>%
      distinct(VG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "VG_ID"
  )

instrain_related <- instrain_related %>%
  mutate(ARG = if_else(is.na(ARG), "No", ARG)) %>%
  mutate(ATB_med_M = if_else(is.na(ATB_med_M), "No", ATB_med_M))


# Expected classif proportion
exp_prop_classif = instrain_related %>%
  distinct(VG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
exp_prop_classif = as.data.frame(exp_prop_classif)

exp_prop_classif = exp_prop_classif %>%
  mutate(ARG = factor(ARG, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
         ATB_med_M = factor(ATB_med_M, levels = c("No", "Yes")))

table(exp_prop_classif$classif)
```

## 2.1 Effect of classif on ARG carriage
```{r}
tab_classif <- table(exp_prop_classif$ARG, exp_prop_classif$classif)
tab_classif

chisq.test(tab_classif) 
fisher.test(tab_classif)
```

## 2.2 Effect of district Antibiotics (M) on ARG carriage
```{r}
tab_atb <- table(exp_prop_classif$ARG, exp_prop_classif$ATB_med_M)
tab_atb

chisq.test(tab_atb)
fisher.test(tab_atb) 
```

## 2.3 Effect of district on ARG carriage
```{r}
# District
tab_dis <- table(exp_prop_classif$ARG, exp_prop_classif$district)
tab_dis

chisq.test(tab_dis)
fisher.test(tab_dis)

# District categories
tab_dis_c <- table(exp_prop_classif$ARG, exp_prop_classif$district_cat)
tab_dis_c

chisq.test(tab_dis_c)

fisher.test(tab_dis_c)
```

## 2.3 Combined effects on ARG carriage
```{r}
# Effect of district_cat adjusted by classif (= Is the probability that a transmitted strain carries an ARG associated with district (rural vs urban) and/or nutritional classification, after adjusting for each other?)
# Set reference = normally nourished babies in urban districts
exp_prop_classif <- exp_prop_classif %>%
  mutate(district_cat = relevel(factor(district_cat), ref = "Urban"))

model <- glm(ARG ~ district_cat + classif,
             data = exp_prop_classif,
             family = binomial)

summary(model)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(model), confint(model)))

model_tidy <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   # remove intercept
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
                  "district_catRural" = "Rural vs Urban",
                  "classifOvernourished" = "ON vs NN",
                  "classifUndernourished" = "UN vs NN")
  )


forest = ggplot(model_tidy, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)),
            vjust = -1.5,
            #hjust = -0.1,
            size = 6) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio (log scale)",
       y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16))

rm(model)
```

## 2.4 Remove unnecessary data
```{r}
rm(tab_atb, tab_classif, tab_dis, tab_dis_c)
```

# 3. By species ARG carriage
```{r}
# Reshape to long format: keep Species and resistance genes
resistance_long_C <- abricate %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(MAGs, VG_ID, Database, NUM_FOUND, `#FILE`, Species, howborn, classif, ATB_med_M, ARG), #, district, district_cat
               names_to = "Resistance_Gene",
               values_to = "Presence"
               )

# Filter for Present Genes (non-NA) and count Occurrences by Species and Resistance Gene
resistance_counts_C <- resistance_long_C %>%
  filter(!is.na(Presence)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Species, Resistance_Gene, howborn, classif, ATB_med_M, ARG)

# Plot data
length(unique(resistance_counts_C$Resistance_Gene)) # Make a color palette with 5 colors

resistance_counts_C_filt <- resistance_counts_C %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species)) # Remove the rows for which Species = NA

resistance_counts_C_filt$Species <- str_wrap(resistance_counts_C_filt$Species, width = 30)

res = ggplot(resistance_counts_C_filt, aes(x = classif, y = n, fill = Resistance_Gene)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Normally nourished" = "NN",
                            "Overnourished" = "ON",
                            "Undernourished" = "UN")) +
  labs(title = NULL, # "Resistance Genes per Species"
       x = NULL, # "Species"
       y = "Number of Genes Detected",
       fill = "Resistance Gene") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), # angle = 45, hjust = 1
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 21),
        legend.position = "right") +
  facet_wrap(~ Species)

rm(res)
```
